goal: Let node operators and external mining clients observe memory used by active block templates
Prevents invisible memory bloat when external clients retain templates holding evicted transactions
agreement: Concept support because tracking memory load helps bound template memory use (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing on mainnet with a Stratum v2 template provider for twenty hours (xyzconstant)
Verified commit ordering and mutex locking across threads (enirox001, vasild)
Unanswered question on whether the interface struct should be a primitive (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because external mining clients can retain templates indefinitely and cause untracked memory pressure
Enables consumers like Stratum v2 template providers to monitor and manage template memory usage
